# Metric dictionary

<!-- Generated by `python scripts/generate.py` from `core/metrics_registry.py`. Do not edit. -->

Methodology version `1.0.0`, schema version `1.0.0`. The registry declares 130 metrics; 60 of them are published as queryable columns in the asset-level `market` table today (the *Published* column). *Declared* means the definition is fixed but the current dataset does not yet carry a value for it; it is listed so nobody has to guess what it will mean.

Every null has a meaning (*Missing means*). Atlas never turns an unknown into a zero.

## Scope: asset

## Scope: venue_asset

| Metric | Unit | Type | Published | Description | Formula | Min venues | Min history | Missing means | Caveats |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `venue_price_usd` | usd | float | declared | One venue's USD-normalised price for an asset. | `venue mid price when both sides quote, else last price, times fx_rate_to_usd` | 1 |  | not_collected |  |
| `venue_reference_weight` | ratio | float | declared | Normalised, capped weight this venue received in reference_price. | `see docs/METHODOLOGY.md, section Global reference price` |  |  | not_applicable |  |
| `venue_deviation_bps` | bps | float | declared | This venue's price relative to reference_price, in basis points. | `10000 * (venue_price_usd - reference_price) / reference_price` |  |  | not_collected |  |
| `venue_spread_bps` | bps | float | declared | Top-of-book spread on this venue, in basis points of the mid. | `10000 * (ask - bid) / ((ask + bid) / 2)` |  |  | not_collected | Quoted spread at one instant, not an achieved execution cost. |
| `venue_quote_volume_24h` | quote_asset | float | declared | Venue-reported 24-hour volume in the instrument's quote currency. | - |  |  | not_supported | Venue-reported. Some venues publish only base volume, in which case this is null. |
| `venue_volume_share` | ratio | float | declared | This venue's share of the asset's reported USD volume. | - |  |  | not_collected |  |
| `venue_liquidity_share` | ratio | float | declared | This venue's share of the asset's 50 bps visible depth. | - |  |  | not_collected |  |
| `venue_funding_rate_raw` | ratio | float | declared | Funding rate exactly as the venue publishes it, before rescaling. | - |  |  | not_supported | Interpret only together with venue_funding_interval_hours. |
| `venue_funding_interval_hours` | hours | float | declared | The venue's native funding interval in hours. | - |  |  | not_supported | Observed intervals range from 1 to 8 hours across venues.; Derived from the venue's own funding timestamps where it does not publish it. |
| `venue_mark_price_usd` | usd | float | declared | Venue mark price, USD-normalised. | - |  |  | not_supported |  |
| `venue_open_interest_raw` | contracts | float | declared | Open interest exactly as the venue publishes it, before conversion. | - |  |  | not_supported | Interpret only together with the instrument's open-interest unit. |
| `venue_exclusion_reason` | enum | str | declared | Why this observation was excluded, or null when it was included. | - |  |  | not_applicable |  |

## Scope: instrument

| Metric | Unit | Type | Published | Description | Formula | Min venues | Min history | Missing means | Caveats |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `instrument_id` | identifier | str | declared | Canonical instrument identifier, for example instrument:okx:linear-perp:BTC-USDT-SWAP. | - |  |  | not_applicable |  |
| `instrument_type` | enum | str | declared | spot, perpetual, future or option. | - |  |  | not_applicable |  |
| `symbol_native` | identifier | str | declared | The venue's own symbol, preserved verbatim so it can be used against its API. | - |  |  | not_applicable |  |
| `contract_multiplier` | ratio | float | declared | Units of the contract-value currency represented by one contract. | - |  |  | not_supported | Never inferred. Null when the venue does not publish it, which excludes the instrument from open-interest normalisation. |
| `is_inverse` | boolean | bool | declared | Whether the contract settles in the base asset rather than the quote. | - |  |  | not_applicable |  |
| `instrument_active` | boolean | bool | declared | Whether the venue reported the instrument tradeable at discovery time. | - |  |  | not_applicable |  |
| `listing_time` | timestamp | timestamp | declared | When the venue says the instrument was listed. | - |  |  | not_supported |  |
| `expiry` | timestamp | timestamp | declared | Contract expiry; null for spot and perpetual instruments. | - |  |  | not_applicable |  |
| `first_seen_at` | timestamp | timestamp | declared | First Atlas discovery run that observed this instrument. | - |  |  | not_applicable |  |
| `last_seen_at` | timestamp | timestamp | declared | Most recent Atlas discovery run that observed this instrument. | - |  |  | not_applicable | An instrument absent from the venue catalogue keeps its last_seen_at. |
